body: Leftovers deferred from the catalog, doctor and docs tickets. (1) skills/modernize/scripts/audit.mjs: the candidateModels list (~line 451) still names retired slugs (gemini-3.7/3.6-flash, gemini-3.1-pro-high, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6-thinking); replace it with the live catalog from lib/models.mjs ALL_MODELS (or the same literal list) so Stage 1 identifies the current models; run `npm run skills:sync` to refresh the .claude/skills and .agents/skills mirrors. (2) Document the new `Model catalog` row in website/content/docs/reference/cli/doctor.mdx (pass or warn only; warns when agy is unavailable, the listing is empty, or the catalog drifts from lib/models.mjs). (3) Replace retired model names in website/content/docs/reference/calibration.mdx (the `Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Thinking)` probe example; leave the dated historical probe row alone), reference/agy-integration.mdx (`Gemini 3.5 Flash (Low)` example) and reference/cli/probe.mdx if it names a retired model. Do not edit design-history pages. Run `cd website && npm run gen` and commit website/generated if it changes. Acceptance: npm test green; grep for retired slugs in website/content/docs outside design-history and dated calibration rows returns nothing; audit.mjs Stage 1 lists only live models.
title: Follow-ups from the agy 1.4.7 / adlc 1.12.0 modernize pass
